captions.caption: A person places a leaf-wrapped bundle onto a stone griddle with holes.
The person's hands adjust the leaf-wrapped bundle on the heated griddle.
A close-up shows a fire burning brightly inside a primitive brick stove.
Water is poured from a gourd onto the leaf-wrapped bundle on the griddle.
The leaf-wrapped bundle steams as water is poured over it from a gourd.
The leaf-wrapped bundle continues to steam on the stone griddle.
A shirtless man in primitive clothing pours water from a gourd onto the stove.
The man continues pouring water onto the stove to generate steam.
Steam rises from the leaf-wrapped bundle as it cooks on the griddle.
The man tends to the fire inside the brick stove while kneeling outside.
The man uses a stick to arrange the wood in the fire.
The man uses two sticks to lift the cooked leaf bundle from the griddle.
The man carries the cooked bundle on a small mat towards his hut.
The man inspects the steaming leaf-wrapped bundle while kneeling.
The man unwraps the leaf to reveal a perfectly cooked fish.
The man begins to peel the meat away from the fish bones.
The man sits inside a small clay hut and starts eating the fish.
A close-up shot shows the man's fingers picking at the cooked fish meat.
Text "Elderberry Wine" appears as a hand picks white elderberries.
Hands carefully pick clusters of white elderberries from a bush.
The man continues to gather white elderberries into a woven basket.
A close-up shows the woven basket filling with fresh white elderberries.
The man stands in a dense thicket, holding the basket of berries high.
The man continues to hold the basket of elderberries amidst the foliage.
A hand reaches into the basket and sorts through the white elderberries.
The man's hands mash the elderberries inside a stone mortar.
The man continues to crush and mash the berries with his fingers.
The man works inside his hut, processing the elderberries in the mortar.
A close-up shows the man's hand squeezing juice from the berry pulp.
The man squeezes the remaining juice from a handful of mashed elderberries.
The man pours more juice into a large clay pot inside the hut.
Water is poured from a gourd into the clay pot with the berries.
A stream of water continues to fill the clay pot, creating a frothy mixture.
The mixture of elderberries and water settles in the clay pot.
The man holds up a square woven mat to cover the clay pot.
The man places the woven mat over the opening of the clay pot.
The man ensures the clay pot is properly covered with the mat.
The man lifts the woven mat cover from the clay pot.
The man uses a wooden stick to stir the fermenting elderberry mixture.
The man continues to stir the contents of the large clay pot.
The man kneels in the hut's entrance, stirring the elderberry wine.
The man continues stirring as the light from the setting sun enters the hut.
The man filters the elderberry wine into a bowl using a woven strainer.
The man takes a long drink from a bowl of freshly made wine.
The man lowers the bowl and looks satisfied with the elderberry wine.
The man sits quietly in the hut, enjoying the results of his work.
Firelight illuminates primitive drawings on the interior wall of the hut.
A close-up reveals intricate markings and drawings on the hut's clay wall.
The man lies down on his side to sleep in the firelit hut.
The man settles onto a mat and closes his eyes for the night.
The man is shown sleeping peacefully in the warm glow of the fire.
Text "Black Sage Seed" appears as a hand reaches for a seed pod.
The man harvests dry black sage seed pods from a bush.
The man gathers more black sage pods into his woven basket.
The man shakes the tiny seeds from the pods into a ceramic bowl.
A close-up shows the bowl filled with small, brown black sage seeds.
The man's hand moves through the seeds in the bowl.
The man takes a small handful of black sage seeds.
The man eats the black sage seeds while standing outdoors.
The man places the bowl of seeds on top of his woven basket.
